kate (Sales): hi @team — kicking off Nimbus Labs POC request. they want EU data residency + VPC private deployment, 14-day eval, target 15 rps, 8k context. billing contact billing@nimbus.ai.

omar (Solutions): thanks kate. quick clarifying q: do they need a hosted trial org first or go straight to private nodes?

kate (Sales): Nimbus prefers private but open to a hosted warm-up if it speeds validation. they asked specifically for a hard spend cap and daily alerts for cost spikes.

julia (FinOps): we can create a trial org with €4,000 promo credits and a hard spend cap. daily alert threshold option available (percentage or fixed €). which do they prefer?

mike (Infra): network note: for EU private deployment we need the VPC region and whether they'd accept our EU-maintenance IPs. sample minimal network details we need: ```region: eu-west-1
vpc_id: vpc-1234abcd
allowed_egress: ["0.0.0.0/0"]
maintainer_ips: ["18.197.0.0/22"]```

nimbus-bot: Nimbus submitted a security RFI. Document CID: RFI-332.

omar (Solutions): we can lock their project to a model_allowlist and disable cross-region fallback to satisfy data residency. also recommend starting with hosted keys to smoke-test integration before provisioning private nodes. Typical timeline: hosted keys same day, private node 3-6 business days if EU capacity available.

julia (FinOps): proposing: create trial org "nimbus-poc-eu", seed €4,000, set hard cap at €4,000 and daily alert at €150. Do they want invoice/PO or card acceptance for overages (if any)?

kate (Sales): @billing@nimbus.ai confirms card on file; no PO. They asked to restrict access to only inference endpoints (no embeddings) for the POC.

omar (Solutions): will add endpoint restrictions. internal CLI we use (example): ```rwctl projects create --org nimbus-poc-eu --billing_email billing@nimbus.ai --credits 4000 --hard_cap 4000 --daily_alert 150 --endpoints inference --model_allowlist gpt-8k,redwood-lite```

mike (Infra): note on EU ops: we need to schedule a short maintenance window for initial sync (we do image pulls). prefer 30m window during business hours CET. I'll add maintenance_cidr to the ticket.

nimbus-bot: ticket created: POC-994 (nimbus-eu-private) — assignee: mike.

julia (FinOps): after org creation I'll attach the promo credit and set billing project id. Kate — when org is ready please don't share any real API keys in public channels. We'll deliver ephemeral keys separately via the customer portal.

kate (Sales): confirmed. I'll DM the contact and close the loop once keys are live.

omar (Solutions): one more ask from Nimbus: telemetry retention needs to be 7 days for logs and 90 days for metrics. we can support that for trial but must document it in the runbook.

mike (Infra): accepted — will set logs=7d metrics=90d for that billing project.

julia (FinOps): next steps: (1) Nimbus provide VPC id and confirm maintainer IP allowlist, (2) FinOps creates org + credits, (3) Infra schedules private node provision and maintenance window, (4) Solutions provides ephemeral hosted keys for initial smoke test and locks model list.

kate (Sales): I'll collect network info now and update the thread. Thanks everyone! :sparkles:
